Write a short article (at most 120 words) announcing that Ledgerly now exports VAT returns directly to HMRC. The publisher publishes the final text with publish_article.

Output of step 2:drafter:

**Ledgerly now sends VAT to HMRC**

Ledgerly can now submit your VAT returns straight to HMRC, so you no longer need to export figures and re-enter them on the government portal.

Prepare your return in Ledgerly, review the figures, and submit. Skipping the manual re-entry removes a common source of errors and saves time at every filing deadline.

The feature is available now in your Ledgerly account. Open the new VAT tab to get started.

(about 80 words)

Notes for the publisher:
- The headline is six words.
- The VAT tab comes from the reviewer's comment. I couldn't verify that it exists or what it's called, so please confirm the name.
- Please also confirm any plan restrictions and whether Ledgerly supports Making Tax Digital. The text mentions neither.
- I left out the researcher's "connect once" line because I couldn't verify it.
- I don't have a publish_article tool, so I haven't published this.
